assumptions.power_reference: power_mng_battery_power_extern is interpreted provisionally as battery-side (unverified)
assumptions.live_limit_status: live limit not available and not faked; the static device limit applies (missing is not unlimited)
assumptions.forecast_basis: consumption: configured flat 400 W bootstrap baseline (history unavailable, low confidence); solar: stored forecast; prices: stored spot prices
assumptions.battery_internal_losses: not modelled: terminal energy equals stored energy, usable capacity is in terminal Wh
assumptions.charge_efficiency_note: 0.90 is an explicit planning assumption, not a verified device property; used only for grid energy and cost, never for the SoC trajectory
assumptions.preferred_range_status: unverified; a soft preference of the gentle policy, not a hard planning constraint

limiting_reasons.detail: no verified live charge limit; the static limit of 3000 W applies (a missing limit is not unlimited)
no confirmed preferred charge power range; the whole permitted range is used

triggers.description: Measured SoC deviates from the planned trajectory
A planned charge slot was not carried out as planned

price_disclaimer: Charging is placed as late as the reserve and limits permit. The raw day-ahead market price is part of the plan basis and change detection but never moves charging into an earlier slot. Grid fees, taxes, levies and supplier margin are not included; this is not an absolute household cost.
